system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: every documentation contribution (skill or changelog) mechanically enters the agent’s runtime context at zero marginal effort
system_prompt_style.note: Analyzer uses a system prompt referencing the 22-class taxonomy; PitfallStore entries are surfaced at diagnosis time.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the Analyzer LLM queries by tag at diagnosis time
env_context_strategy.note: Tag-keyed SQLite PitfallStore lookup plus injected log windows; the paper states there is no embedding lookup. The value list fits poorly.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: with a hardcoded 4 KB truncation window per source

observation_format.evidence_quote: feed the log window plus a system prompt (which references the 22-class failure taxonomy of §7) to an LLM completion call

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The Router then emits a JSON envelope ({intent, business_line, p_date, model_ variant, overrides?} ) that is validated against a Pydantic schema before the DAG is dispatched.
tool_call_format.note: Actions are ultimately CLI-tool dispatches (query, run-sql, gpu-train).

tool_count.note: The paper reports 29 skills but no tool schema count.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Each skill’s SKILL.md declares a frontmatter description field consumed by the Router LLM

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The agent tier is invoked by life- cycle events (IM webhook, HITL card callback, training-completion sentinel)
loop_primitives.note: The ChatOps DAG is a fixed pipeline with an Analyzer→retry repair loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: A LangGraph-based stateful DAG that de- composes a request into a sequence of skill invocations

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: our nodes are pipeline stages, not personas

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: we share the multi-step orchestration pattern but discard the role-specialized agent metaphor

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: control does not return to the DAG until an authorized operator approves or rejects the Analyzer’s proposed remediation
human_in_loop.note: Also used for threshold and champion-model selection.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: We use a single Pydantic state ob- ject (PipelineState) persisted as JSON in SQLite via aiosqlite.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: A rule-based extractor compiles these tables into a single SQLite-backed PitfallStore.
long_term_memory.note: The PitfallStore is closest to episodic_db / file notes.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: resumes a paused DAG by reading PipelineState from SQLite, applying the operator’s approval, and continuing from the paused node

self_verification.evidence_quote: sandboxed unit tests in the training subgraph
self_verification.note: Described as team conventions, not hard gates.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Runs already attempted for this job, gates automatic retry cap
retry_policy.note: Retries are gated by human approval.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Rejection ends the pipeline with a recorded failure record.
termination_condition.note: The DAG ends at Done or on rejection; the retry budget acts as a cap.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: we discard the sandboxed-Docker abstraction in favor of explicit infrastructure-tier coupling

permission_model.evidence_quote: no executive action is taken without explicit operator approval

tracing.evidence_quote: the CLI-call telemetry where command='gpu- train'AND status='failed'

replayability.evidence_quote: deployed as an audit-trail primitive (schema-validated, idempotent, replayable)

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: The benchmark harness has been implemented under tests/analyzer_taxonomy_bench.py

guardrails.evidence_quote: Envelope-level validation errors return an inline error card to the user rather than start- ing the DAG

target_domain.evidence_quote: an LLM-agent platform for indus- trial recommender lifecycle operations

first_release_date.note: Based on the paper v1 date.

pinned_version.note: The paper describes v1.0; no repo is available.
